background:
Create a major visual remaster background for Rua de Aço, a premium detailed 16-bit pixel-art side-view fighting game, 16:9 landscape. The existing stage has a plain blocky navy skyline, warehouses, yellow dock lamps, thin cranes, flat cyan lake ripples and a gray quay. Reimagine that same setting with sophisticated pixel-art detail. Preserve the identity of a Brazilian industrial city quay at night: distant blue urban skyline, dock warehouses at the far edges, a few thin cranes, warm amber dock lamps, dark navy/cyan atmosphere and a wide waterside fighting platform. Do not include fighters, HUD, buttons, text or interface. Output ONLY the empty stage artwork, no borders.
Precise target composition for 640x360 logical pixels: dark open night sky top 0-145; skyline silhouette with windows begins around y145 and ends at waterline y225; lake spans y225-274; front fighting quay begins y274 and has broad flat blue-gray wet stone/metal paving through y324 with its thin industrial front face y324-360. Flat side-view fighting floor, not a vanishing-point street. Keep the central fighting zone open. Detailed natural water with long broken warm city reflections and cool silver-blue ripples; wet paving glints, rich low-contrast material texture, coherent cool moonlight from upper right and amber sidelighting, subtle atmospheric haze, beautiful cinematic depth. Sophisticated and finely textured while remaining crisp pixel art, not flat primitive rectangles, not smooth 3D. No actual moon: leave an unobstructed dark patch centered x430 y100 for a separately animated 64-pixel moon. No boats, creatures, UFOs, witch, beams, fire or fireworks in the background, because those are separate animated objects. Avoid bright clutter near fighter silhouettes. Retain dark night mood with enough value separation to see details on a phone. Full-bleed rectangular art.
props:
Production sprite asset atlas for a richly detailed 16-bit pixel-art fighting game at a blue moonlit industrial lake. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Exactly TWO columns by TWO rows of isolated objects, each object fully contained in its equal cell with at least 12% transparent padding on all sides. No cell borders, labels, lettering, background, water or decorative layout. Crisp polished pixel clusters, realistic material details readable at small game size, blue/silver moonlight and muted amber accents.
TOP LEFT cell: one beautiful round full moon with nuanced ivory-silver lunar maria, craters, darker lower-left relief and brighter upper-right rim. Entire circular moon only, no stars or halo. Near-perfect circular silhouette.
TOP RIGHT cell: one classic flying saucer in side / very slight low-three-quarter view, metallic silver-blue disc, short cyan glass dome, thin broad rim, a few small cyan and amber navigation lamps, dark underside with central circular emitter. Entire craft isolated, no beam or exhaust. It will display at 96x48 logical pixels.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: an old witch flying on a long wooden broom toward the RIGHT, side view, pointed crooked hat, dark purple cloak, profile face, hair trailing left, straw broom end at left and narrow broom handle pointing right. Believable painted pixel sprite, entire hat and broom visible. It will display at 72x48.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: a small pirate sailing ship facing RIGHT, side view, dark richly detailed wooden hull, TWO masts, weathered cream sails, tiny dark skull flag, short row of round cannon ports along the hull with one forward-facing cannon muzzle. Entire ship including hull, flags, sails visible and isolated, no water, smoke, cannonballs or other objects. It will display at 144x110.
All four objects separated on transparent background, consistent polished pixel-art craftsmanship. Do not crop any object.
monster:
A horizontal four-frame animation sprite sheet on TRUE transparent RGBA background for a premium 16-bit pixel-art fighting game. EXACTLY FOUR equal cells in ONE ROW, no second row, no text, borders, grid, background, water surface or detached effects. The SAME lake monster in every frame: imposing but readable dark teal sea-serpent / plesiosaur with a long thick sinuous upright neck, small spiky dorsal ridge, dragon-like head facing up and slightly RIGHT, amber eyes, wet scale details and silver-blue moonlit edges. Upper body only, broad submerged shoulder/base cut ends at the SAME horizontal baseline in all four frames; this is the part emerging above water. Entire visible head and neck contained in each cell with 12% transparent padding, no contact with adjacent cells. Identical monster size, anatomy and aligned base across frames.
Frame 1: raised neck with mouth closed, calm menacing breathing.
Frame 2: raises snout almost vertically and opens jaws, preparing to breathe fire upward.
Frame 3: open jaws aimed almost vertically upward, head leaned back in a sustained roaring/fire-breathing pose; NO actual flame (fire will be separately animated).
Frame 4: subtle recoil from a cannon impact, head slightly back and jaws partly closing, SAME creature and scale.
Richly textured polished pixel art, clean alpha silhouettes, dark cyan/navy scales with restrained gold glints, no gore, no cartoon emoji appearance. Designed to be downsampled to four 128x144 logical-pixel frames.
effects: Game VFX sprite sheet, polished detailed pixel art, TRUE transparent RGBA background, no background color or glow outside each effect. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, generous 15% transparent gutters so every effect fits its cell fully, no frames/borders/text. TOP ROW: four consecutive animation frames of a narrow jet of dragon fire going STRAIGHT UP from a tiny fixed origin at the bottom center of each cell. Tall orange flames with ragged curling tongues, red-orange outer contour, golden yellow core and pale hot base. All flames aligned to identical bottom origin, similar height, expressive natural variation between frames. Flame only, no creature, no logs, no ground, no smoke wall. BOTTOM ROW: four consecutive small water surface splashes, first expanding spray then falling droplets then ripple settlement, turquoise deep-blue moonlit lake water with restrained silver highlights. Each splash low and wide with all droplets contained in its cell, identical centered waterline baseline. No lake background, no giant foam mass, no black shadow rectangle. Pixel-art matching a moonlit urban fighting-game stage. Preserve clean transparent edges. Top-row effects will be rendered about 40x80 game pixels; bottom row about 96x32.
